items.text: Previously, Essex Police found 39 dead people in a truck in England, and the police thought that they were Chinese. This was based on the documentation that they found in the truck. However, officials announced that the dead people are probably Vietnamese. Police used the international database, Interpol, to help them identify the bodies. Their methods included dental comparison , fingerprints , and DNA analysis. It was necessary to consider the needs of the relatives of the dead people, as well as the community. The 25-year-old driver of the truck is suspected of murder and human trafficking . Difficult words: dental comparison (a method of identifying a person based on his or her dental records at their dentist), fingerprints (marks that people leave on objects when they touch them), human trafficking (an illegal activity which involves transporting humans to another place usually to do some kind of work). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In October, British police found 39 dead people in a truck. The police also found some documents in the truck which made them think that the people were Chinese. However, it seems that the dead people were Vietnamese. The police use various methods to find out who the dead people were. They compared their teeth and fingerprints , and they analyzed their DNA. They also considered the families of the dead people and their community. The police believe that the 25-year-old driver of the truck killed the people. They suspect him of human trafficking. Difficult words: various (many different kinds), fingerprints (marks that a person leaves on an object then he or she touches it with his or her fingers), suspect (to believe that someone did something), human trafficking (when people sell or trade or other people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In October, British police find 39 dead people in a truck. The police also find some documents in the truck. The police believe that these people are Chinese. This does not seem to be true now. These people are probably Vietnamese. The police use different ways to find out who the people are. They check their teeth and their fingerprints . They also look at their DNA . This is a difficult situation for the families and communities of the dead people. Therefore, the police must work carefully. The police believe that the driver of the truck is the murderer . Difficult words: fingerprints (a mark that stays on an object when a person touches it with their fingers and then police use it to find out who the person is), DNA (the “code” in your body that says who you are), murderer (a person who kills somebody). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

India’s capital, New Delhi, is considered one of the world’s 10 most polluted cities and at this time, there is an emergency due to thick smog . The smog has reached dangerous levels which is usual for this time of year because farmers burn their leftover crops at this time. Also at this time, people celebrate Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights. During the festival, they set off many fireworks. However, the government bans both practices in India. Smog can cause breathing problems, high blood pressure, or a heart attack. New Delhi’s chief minister says that public health is at risk. Officials are trying to reduce the number of cars on the road. They have also closed schools, and they asked people to stay at home. Difficult words: polluted (dirty), smog (very dirty air because of smoke), leftover (something that is not used or consumed). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

India’s capital, New Delhi, is among the 10 dirtiest cities in the world. Currently, there is an emergency because of smog . Farmers caused this problem because they burned unused crops , and people celebrated a festival of lights with many fireworks. A New Delhi’s official says that the situation is very dangerous for people. The air is very dirty and it is difficult to breathe. Besides all this, people can have high blood pressure or get a heart attack. Officials lowered the number of cars on roads, closed schools, and asked people to stay at home. Difficult words: smog (very dirty air which looks like fog), crops (plants that farmers grow in fields), heart attack (a state when a heart stops working properly). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

New Delhi is the capital city of India. It is a very dirty city. At this time of year, farmers burn the plants which they do not sell. People also celebrate a festival of lights. There are a lot of fireworks . These activities make the air very dirty. People cannot breathe easily. They can have high blood pressure or problems with their hearts. The situation is very dangerous. Officials want fewer cars on roads. People must stay at home. Children cannot go to schools. Difficult words: capital (the most important city in a country), firework (an object that people light; it explodes in the air which makes colorful displays in the sky), blood pressure (how hard the heart beats or works inside the body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Fitbit is a company that tracks fitness and exercise through wearable technology. Google made an agreement to acquire Fitbit, and it says that Fitbit is worth about $2.1 billion. The agreement may close sometime next year. The agreement will help both companies. Google has struggled to do well with wearable technology which Apple and Samsung dominate in this area. Fitbit has also struggled because other companies have more money to spend on their wearable technology. Before the ink dries on the deal , Fitbit said that it will keep its health and fitness data private, and it will never use its data for Google ads. Difficult words: acquire (to gain, to take on), dominate (to take control), the ink dries on the deal (traditional agreements or deals were signed on paper with ink that took time to dry; in this context, this means that Fitbit quickly said it will keep its health and fitness data private). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Fitbit is a company that makes wearable technology that you can wear to track your fitness or exercise. Google and Fitbit made a deal for Google to acquire Fitbit. Google says that Fitbit is worth about $2.1 billion. The deal helps both companies because both of them are struggling with wearable technology. For Google, Apple and Samsung are the leaders of the technology, and for Fitbit, other companies have more money to spend. Fitbit said that it is going to keep its health and fitness data private, and it is not going to use its data for Google ads. Difficult words: track (to measure, to follow), acquire (to gain, to add), struggle (to do something difficult). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Fitbit is a company that makes wearable technology. Google and Fitbit make a deal. Google is going to add Fitbit to its company. Google says that Fitbit is worth about $2.1 billion. The deal is going to help both companies. Google is not selling much wearable technology. Apple and Samsung are the leaders of wearable technology. Fitbit does not have a lot of money to spend to make better technology. Other companies have a lot more money. Fitbit says that it is going to keep its health and fitness data private . It is not going to use its data for Google ads. Difficult words: wearable technology (a device that you can wear to measure your exercise activity), health and fitness data (the information that comes from your exercise activity such as how long you exercise, how much your heart beats, or how far you step), private (when only one person can see something that is his). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On August 3, 2019, a gunman killed 22 people at a Walmart in El Paso, Texas, and he told police that he targeted people that he believed were “Mexicans.” El Paso is a town where more than 80% of its people are Hispanic. For this year’s Dia de los Muertos celebration, people dedicated special altars to the victims of that shooting. Traditionally, people dedicate altars for their loved ones who died. They include in the altars flowers, candles, and candy made out of sugar that looks like skulls. A museum in Chicago also dedicated an altar to the victims in El Paso. The museum president said that the altar used crosses and balloons with the number 22. Difficult words: target (to look for something), altar (a religious structure where you put objects to respect a religious figure or a person), dedicate (to create and to honor). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On August 3, 2019, a gunman killed 22 people at a store in El Paso, Texas. He told police that he shot people that he thought were “Mexicans.” More than 80% of the people who live in El Paso are Hispanic or Latino . Dia de los Muertos is a Mexican holiday that people also celebrate in the USA. For this year, people created special altars to the victims who died at that store in El Paso. Usually, people create altars for their relatives who died. They put objects in the altars such as flowers, candles, and candy that looks like skulls. A Chicago museum also created an altar for the victims. Difficult words: Hispanic (a person who comes from a country where people speak Spanish), Latino (a person who comes from Latin America which is south of North America and is where people speak Spanish), altar (a small religious space where you put objects to respect a religious person or a person who you know). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On, August 3, 2019, a gunman shoots at people in a store. This happens in El Paso, Texas. He kills 22 people. He tells police that he shoots at people that he thinks are “ Mexicans .” Dia de los Muertos is a Mexican holiday. People also celebrate it in the USA. People make little areas called “altars” to remember the people who died. Usually, people remember their relatives who died . For this year, people remember the victims who died in El Paso. They put objects in the altars such as flowers, candles, and candy skulls. A Chicago museum also makes an altar for the victims. Difficult words: gunman (a person who carries a gun or many guns on him), Mexican (a person who comes from Mexico; some people use this word to mean people who look like they come from Mexico), victim (a person who dies or gets hurt in an event), died (the past tense of “to die”). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The US president Donald Trump announced that the US troops will leave northern Syria. There are Turkish, Russian, and Syrian forces who want to move to this area. For the Syrian Kurds, this is a life-threatening situation and many of them decide to flee from Syria. They want to get to a refugee camp in northern Iraq. It is very difficult to get to the camp because the Syrian-Iraqi border is closed to refugees. This means that they must get to the camp illegally, and they usually spend all the money that they had. When they arrive, they get a tent and food for several days. However, there is only limited help from organizations which operate in the camp. Difficult words: life-threatening (dangerous to live in), flee (to run away from a country because of danger), refugee (a person who leaves a country because of war on natural disaster). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US army is leaving Syria. This is very bad news for people in Syria because Turkish, Russian, and Syrian troops want to move into this area. Life in Syria can be dangerous for Syrian Kurds, so they decide to escape and go to a camp in northern Iraq. However, the Syrian-Iraqi border is closed to them. They spend all their money to get to the camp illegally. When they come, they get a tent and some food. The food lasts them only a few days, and the organizations in the camp do not help them very much. Difficult words: troops (soldiers), escape (to run away), border (the line which divides two countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The lives of Syrian Kurds change. The US army leaves. Other armies want to go to the country. Syria is not a safe place to live. Many Syrian Kurds decide to leave. They escape to Iraq. There is a big camp for people from Syria there. The problem is that the border is closed between Syria and Iraq. It is not legal to come to Iraq. Syrian people spend a lot of money to get to the camp. However, life in the camp is very difficult. People get a tent and some food when they come. They do not get much food after some days. There are some organizations to help. However, they do not help very much. Difficult words: escape (to run away from a place), camp (a place where people live in tents), border (the line between two countries), legal (when it is OK to do something according to your government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Facebook is suing an Israeli company, NSO Group, for hacking 1,400 WhatsApp users in 20 countries. Many of the users were journalists, human rights activists and government officials. Allegedly , NSO used its own software to get to people’s messages. Facebook, which owns WhatsApp, asked its users to update their applications to make access to their phones more difficult for hackers. WhatsApp also added new protections to the system and updated the application. NSO does not agree with the claims . It says that it provides technologies to governments to help them fight terrorism and crime. It also says that it has helped to save thousands of lives in the past. Difficult words: allegedly (it is said that), claim (something what is said and believed to be true), provide (to give for use). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Facebook says, that an Israeli company, NSO Group, hacked 1,400 WhatsApp users. The people it hacked were mainly journalists, activists , and politicians. Facebook, which owns WhatsApp, also says that NSO used its own software to read people’s messages. Facebook asked its users to update their application which makes it more difficult for hackers to get in their phones. Currently, Facebook is taking legalaction against NSO. NSO does not agree with what Facebook says. It says that it gives technologies to government and law agencies to help fight terrorism and crime. Difficult words: hack (to get to somebody’s phone or computer and steal some data), activist (a person who is not in the government but who works to make change in the government), legalaction (when a person or a company takes someone to court to get help with a problem), law (the rules of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Facebook is in court with NSO. NSO is a company from Israel. The company hacks 1,400 people who have the app WhatsApp. The hackers can read messages in people’s phones. They use a special software which is a part of the video call. People install it. They do not know that it is dangerous. These people are mostly from media and government. Facebook, which owns WhatsApp, says that people must update their app. WhatsApp changes the system to make it safer. NSO says that it does not hack WhatsApp. It says it wants to fight for the truth. It says that it uses technologies to fight crime. Difficult words: court (a place where two sides speak about a problem or crime, and some officials find the truth), hack (to get to somebody’s electronic device and get some information from it), hacker (a person who hacks an electronic device), update (to use a newer version). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

North Korea confirmed another test of its new rocket system, and it has been the third test since August. North Korea fired two projectiles which flew more than 200 miles, and they landed in the sea between North Korea and Japan. According to state media , the new system is able to totally destroy a target. At the beginning of October, the US and North Korea met in Sweden to negotiate North Korea’s nuclear program. However, the meeting was not successful. North Korea’s foreign ministry said that the US must prepare a better offer before the end of this year. Difficult words: confirm (to say that something is going to happen or happened), projectile (an object shot from a gun), State media (the news that a government sends out to its people), negotiate (to discuss). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

North Korea is testing a new rocket system. It is the third time since August. This week, North Korea fired a rocket which flew more than 200 miles and landed in the sea between North Korea and Japan. North Korean news says that this rocket can totally destroy a target. Last month, the US met with North Korea to discuss North Korea’s nuclear program. The meeting did not end well because North Korea said that the US has old-fashioned ideas. The US does not agree with that. However, North Korea says that the US must prepare a better plan before the end of December. Difficult words: fire (to shoot), destroy (to damage something so badly that it is not possible to use it anymore), target (a person or an object which is attacked). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

North Korea tests a new rocket. It is the third test for this rocket since August. This rocket can fly more than 200 miles. It can destroy everything. This week, one rocket falls into the sea near Japan. Last month, the US meets North Korea. They speak about North Korea’s nuclear program. It is not a successful meeting. North Korea does not like the US’s ideas. North Korea warns the US that it must change its plan. The US has time only until the end of December. Difficult words: destroy (to damage something so much that it is not possible to repair it), successful (with a good end), warn (to inform about a possible bad situation in the future). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Twenty-seven countries pledged $9.8 billion to the Green Climate Fund which helps developing countries fight climate change. Donors include Canada, the UK, New Zealand, and Poland. However, The US and Australia did not participate. Former President Barack Obama pledged $3 billion, but current president Donald Trump reduced the number to $1 billion. The Climate Action Network criticized the US and Australia. It says that they do not help the world’s poorest countries, and they isolate themselves from the other helping countries. The director of the Green Climate Fund says that it is possible to find other resources . He also hopes to almost double the fund over the next four years. Difficult words: pledge (a formal promise to give money), donor (a person who or a country which gives money), isolate (to choose not to work with others), resources (money or things which somebody has and can use them when they need). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Twenty-seven countries agreed to pay $9.8 billion to the Green Climate Fund . These countries want to help the world’s poorest countries fight climate change . However, the US and Australia do not want to help. In the past, the US agreed to pay $3 billion to the fund, but when Donald Trump became president, he lowered the help to $1 billion. The Climate Action Network is not very happy with the US and Australian way of thinking. They separate themselves from the rest of the world. The boss of the fund hopes to get some more money and to double the fund in the next four years. Difficult words: fund (the money which somebody saves and then uses it for something special), climate change (the change of weather, temperature and nature on our planet over many years), separate (to stay away from others). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Poor countries cannot care about the environment very well. They do not have good technologies. Twenty-seven rich countries meet at a conference in Paris. They want to help the poorer countries. They agree to pay almost $10 billion to a special fund . The US and Australia do not want to help. The US President, Donald Trump, wants to pay less money than in the past. A climate organization criticizes the US and Australia. The boss of the fund says that this is bad news. He hopes to get more money. He hopes to make a bigger fund in the future. Difficult words: environment (the natural world), fund (the money which somebody saves and then uses it for something special), criticize (to say that something is bad). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are concerns that Iran does not get enough food and medicine help because of sanctions on this country. The Trump administration is working on new regulations for humanitarian aid to Iran. The US wants to make the regulations easier. It is important that Iran still receives food, medicine, and other help. The regulations will also guarantee that the financial aid does not support Iran’s military program and terrorist groups. Steven Mnuchin, the Treasury Department Secretary, says that the new regulations will help international companies with humanitarian trade with Iran. Difficult words: sanction (a form of penalty when a country or countries stop business with another country), regulation (an official rule), humanitarian (the idea that is good to help people in need). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The US worked on a new system of help for people in Iran. Iran is under sanctions because there is a problem with its military program. Some people worry that Iran does not get enough food and medicine. The US thinks that some money from the help to Iran can help military or terrorist groups, and this must change. There must be better rules and control. Officials say that the new system is good for international companies. They can understand the rules better and they can do business with Iran. Difficult words: sanction (a situation when one country stops business with another country because this country does something bad), military (connected with war or soldiers), rules (instructions that tell people what they can do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a bad situation in Iran. There is terrorism . Some countries stop business with Iran. They do not agree with Iranian politics . They are afraid of the war and terrorism. This is not good for the Iranian people. They do not get enough food or medicine. The US wants to make the situation in Iran better. They make a new system to help. There must be more control of the money. The new system is good for international companies. They can better understand what kind of business is good for Iran. Difficult words: terrorism (when leaders of a country or some groups of people kill or do very bad things to other people), politics (a way of leading a country), international (from all over the world). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Thousands of students in Chicago have already missed one week of school. Teachers have been on strike since October 17. They demand smaller class sizes, more staff, and higher pay. Chicago Public Schools (CPS) and the Chicago Teachers Union (CTU) have reached a deal but CTU is not satisfied with it. At the moment, the two sides agree on the main issues, but they cannot agree on exact numbers. CTU also wants CPS to put all promises in writing. The Chicago Mayor, Lori Lightfoot, says that she is very disappointed with CTU’s reaction. She also says that the city does not have enough money for all what CTU wants. However, CTU and teachers believe that the city has a lot of money, but they do not spend it on education. Difficult words: strike (an official protest when people stop working), demand (to ask for something officially), issue (a topic or problem which people discuss). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

There was a strike of teachers in Chicago that started one week ago. Teachers wanted smaller class sizes, more staff , and better money for their work . They had discussions with schools, but it was difficult to find a solution. They did not agree on many things, and the main problem was money. The Chicago Mayor was very unhappy about the situation. He says that the city does not have enough money for all that the teachers want. The teachers think that the city has enough money, and they say that the problem is that the city spends it on other things. Difficult words: strike (an official way to show that somebody does not agree with something, usually by stopping to work), staff (all the people who work in a company or an institution), solution (a way of solving a problem). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Teachers in Chicago, USA, protest. The protests last one week. The teachers want smaller classes and better money. They say that there must be more staff in schools. The teachers speak with schools. They want to solve the difficult situation quickly. It is not easy because they have different ideas from schools. Now, there is a new deal . However, teachers are not happy with it. They do not agree on many things. The biggest problem is money. The Chicago Mayor says that Chicago does not have enough money for the teachers. Teachers do not believe that. They say that there is money. They say that the city spends it on different things. Difficult words: staff (all the people who work at one place), deal (a situation when two sides agree on something), Mayor (a person who leads a town or city). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Real-life stories turned into television (TV) stories are captivating TV audiences. New mainstream shows are about educating people about difficult subjects. This is instead of entertaining them. Education TV shows usually makes you think of documentaries, cooking shows, children’s shows, or the shows on the Discovery Channel. However, the idea of turning true difficult stories into TV shows goes back to the 1970s when the show “Roots” was on TV. It was about American slavery. A TV director said that “Roots” showed people the awful truth about slavery. It made them rethink their preconceived stereotype s. This is happening now. In 2019, people are using the Netflix show “Unbelievable” to find out more about unsolved rapes. These shows from real life are winning awards, and more TV companies are continuing to make them. Difficult words: captivate (to be very interesting), mainstream (common, well-known), preconceived stereotype (an idea that someone already had about another person or a group of people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Companies that make television (TV) shows are turning real-life stories into dramatizations. People are very interested in them. Many the shows are teaching them about something brutal or sad instead of entertaining them. In the 1970s, people took a difficult real event and turned it into a TV show. There was a show called “ Roots ” that was about American slavery. A TV director said that “Roots” showed people how terrible slavery was. It made them think about their ideas about other people. Other shows are doing this now, as people want to find out more about unsolved crimes. Many of these shows about real life are winning awards, and more TV companies want to make them. Difficult words: dramatization (when someone turns a real event into a story), brutal (violent, difficult to watch), roots (the background of where a person comes from). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Companies that make television (TV) shows make a new kinds of shows. They are about real life. They can be sad stories. They can be hard to watch. People are very interested in them. They learn from them. In the 1970s, people make a TV show like this for the first time. It is about American slavery . A TV director says that this show is important. It shows people that slavery is bad. It makes them think differently. TV shows have similar impacts now. One show makes people want to find out more about crimes. They want the police to solve the crimes. Many of these new shows win awards. More TV companies want to make them. Difficult words: slavery (the idea that a person owns another person), similar impact (the same thing happens), solve (find out what happens). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Technology companies Amazon, Google, IBM, Oracle, and Microsoft competed on a cloud system for the US Department of Defense’s Joint Enterprise Defense Infrastructure (JEDI). This is to replace the older computers that are from the 1980s and 1990s. An American official said that the new systems are overdue , as cloud systems are the industry norm . People thought that Amazon would win the competition, but then President Trump criticized Amazon’s CEO. Amazon said that it would keep working on technology that will help in the “digital battlefield.” Microsoft ultimately won the competition. The US government will work with Microsoft for 10 years and $10 billion. Difficult words: cloud system (information that stays on the Internet and that someone else manages), overdue (late), industry norm (something that most people have or do). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Technology companies competed on a cloud system for the US Department of Defense . This is to take the place of computers from the 1980s and 1990s. An American official said that the government needs new systems because they are normal for most agencies or companies. Amazon and Microsoft were two of many companies that competed. People thought that Amazon would win, but then President Trump made negative comments about the boss of Amazon. Microsoft won, which means that that the company and the US government are going to work together for 10 years for $10 billion. Difficult words: compete (to work against someone else to try to be the best), cloud system (information that stays on the Internet), Department of Defense (a part of a government that protects a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Technology companies compete . They work on a cloud system . It is for the US government. The US government has old computers. They are from the 1980s and 1990s. People want new computers. Amazon and Microsoft are two companies that compete. People think that Amazon can win. However, President Trump says comments against the boss of Amazon. Microsoft wins the competition . Microsoft and the US government can work together for 10 years. The US government can pay Microsoft $10 billion. Difficult words: compete (to try to be the best), cloud system (a program that keeps information on the Internet), competition (when people or groups try to be the best). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The 600,000 Muslim Rohingya that remain in Myanmar face systematic persecution and live under the threat of genocide. More than 730,000 escaped from attacks and found safety in Bangladesh. In a two-and-a-half-year fact-finding mission, UN investigators discovered that Myanmar military carried out “clearance operations” in 2017, and they subjected Rohingya to terrible human crimes like torture, sexual violence, and ill treatment. Last month, the UN reported that 600,000 Rohingya Muslims in Myanmar still face the threat of genocide — and the country’s government is doing nothing to stop the crimes. On Tuesday, the leader of the fact-finding mission informed the UN human rights council that the situation of the Rohingya in Rakhine state is serious. According to the Associated Press, the Myanmar government is not following international humanitarian law and is doing nothing to stop these abuses. Rohingya are subjected to segregation , discrimination, and all sorts of brutalities . Difficult words: systematic persecution (regular attacks against people because they are different), segregation (keeping different peoples apart), brutality (a cruel or violent act). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The Rohingya are a small ethnic group who live in Myanmar and who are discriminated by people in Myanmar. A UN official states that people may kill thousands of Rohingya Muslims. The UN investigators discovered that in 2017 Myanmar security officers hurt and violated many Rohingya by doing what they called “clearing operations”. More than 730,000 Rohingya sought refuge in Bangladesh. The UN reports that the Myanmar government is doing nothing to stop the violence. On Tuesday, the leader of the investigators reported that the situation of the Rohingya in Rakhine state is getting worse. He said that the Rohingya are living in continued mistreatment and separation from others, and they do not have “access to land, jobs, education and health care.” Difficult words: ethnic (related to a culture), discriminate (treat a person or people differently), violate (attack sexually), seek refuge (look for shelter or protection from danger). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Rohingya is a small religious minority that lives in Myanmar. They are living in a very serious situation. They are Muslims. They live in a country where Buddhism is the main religion. The Myanmar government attacks the Rohingya. Thousands of them now escape to Bangladesh. A UN official says that the risk of genocide for these people is very high. UN officials find that Myanmar security officers hurt Rohingya through some “clearance operations”. This is when they make Rohingya leave. The UN says that Myanmar is doing nothing. A leader of a UN group says that the situation of Rohingya in the Rakhine state is serious. He says that the government is responsible for the deaths and the crimes against humanity . Difficult words: minority (a small group of people in a place where other people live), escape (avoid capture; get away with something) risk of genocide (how possible it is that a people can kill another people because of their race, religion, political beliefs, or other differences), crime against humanity (when someone hurts or kills ordinary people during war). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In a recent meeting, Indonesian authorities informed the families of the victims of last year’s Boeing 737 Max crash that a systemic design defect caused the crash. Investigators reported that Boeing did not train its pilots to use a new software called MCAS. They assume that the crash was due to MCAS not working, and the pilots did not understand the warnings of the system and its defects. Aviation controllers say that a MCAS system for a second accident when a Boeing 737 Max from Ethiopian Airlines also crashed. Boeing then decided to stop all flights worldwide. On Tuesday, Boeing’s officials dismissed Kevin McAllister, the commercial airplanes division chief who was in charge of the company’s response to the crashes. The Indonesian National Transportation Safety Committee expects to release the final report on Friday. Difficult words: systemic design defect (a problem with the way something is made), assume (be of the opinion, suppose), dismiss (send away someone, remove from an employment). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last year, a Boeing 737 from Lion air crashed in Indonesia, and all of its passengers died. Indonesian authorities told the families of the victims that the crash happened from a flaw in the design. Investigators said that Boeing did not prepare the pilots for its new software, MCAS, and this software was the reason for the crash. The investigators also blamed the pilots and co-pilots because they were not capable of managing the software alerts during the flight. Some months later after the crash in Indonesia, another Boeing from Ethiopian Airlines crashed, killing 346 people. The software also caused the second crash. After this second accident, Boeing decided to stop all flights of the Boeing 737 Max. Difficult words: flaw (a problem) , investigators (inspectors, examiners), capable (have the ability to do something), alert (a warning, a notification). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last year, an Indonesian Boeing 737 Max airplane from Lion Air crashes after take off. All of the people on the plane die in the accident. Some months later, an airplane from Ethiopian Airlines crashes. It is another Boeing 737 Max like the one in Indonesia. After the second crash, all Boeing 737 Max flights stop. Indonesian authorities tell the families of the victims that their airplane crashes because of a problem in the design . Indonesian officials show a report on the accident. They say that the pilots and airlines are not prepared to use a new software. It is called MCAS. The MCAS software does not work correctly. It makes the crash happen. The investigators also say that the pilots do not understand the software’s alerts. Difficult words: take off (when an airplane leaves the ground), design (how people make something), prepared (skilled, trained) alerts (An announcement or signal warning of danger). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

39 Chinese people were found dead in a truck in Essex, southeast England. The police said that 31 of them were men and 8 were women. It will take some time to find out who the people were and why they died. Belgium helped with the investigation because the police thought that the truck came to England from Belgium. The driver was a 25-year-old man. The police arrested him and he is in custody . The British Prime Minister is shocked by what happened. He said that police were working hard to find out what exactly happened. The Essex police said that it was the largest investigation in its history. Difficult words: investigation (the process when police collect information about something bad that happens), arrest (put a person in prison), custody (a situation when somebody is held by police until they solve a case). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Police found 39 dead people in a truck in England. All of the people were Chinese, and some were men and some were women. The driver of the truck was 25 years old, and the police arrested him. The police need time to find out who the dead people were. They also want to know what happened to them. The Belgian police help the English police because it seemed that the truck came from Belgium. This is the biggest case for local English police in their history. They work hard to solve this crime. The British Prime Minister said that this case is shocking . Difficult words: arrest (put a person in prison), case (a situation which police must solve), shocking (very surprising). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A truck comes from Belgium to England. Police find 39 people inside the truck. All of the people are dead. They are Chinese. A young man drives the truck. He is now with the police. He cannot leave. It is a very complicated situation. The police need a lot of time to solve it. They do not have information about the dead people. The British Prime Minister says that this is a horrible case . The police work very hard. It is the biggest case for them. Chinese officials and Belgian police help, too. Difficult words: complicated (very difficult), case (a situation which the police must solve), official (a person from the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In August, India canceled Kashmir’s autonomy which means that Kashmir cannot have its own constitution . Some politicians believe that it will stop terrorism in a region where most people are Muslim. However, this started big protests. Thousands of soldiers came to the area and more than 4000 people were arrested, including many politicians. Recently, Kashmiris elected the leaders of more than 300 local councils. 98 percent of all voters came to vote. Many voters did not feel that the elections were true because so many politicians were arrested. The main political parties boycotted the elections, and independent candidates won around 70 percent of the seats. Difficult words: autonomy (independence), constitution (the political rules of a country), boycott (not take part as a way of a protest). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Kashmir is a Muslim part of India which had its own government . In August, India changed this so that Kashmir could not have its own government. Some politicians thought that this could stop terrorism in Kashmir. People started to protest, so many thousands of soldiers came and put 4000 people in prison. Many officials went to prison, too. Next, there were elections in Kashmir. Almost all people came to vote, but they were not happy about their votes. They said that their votes were not fair because many politicians were in prison. Some big official groups also protested and did not take part in the elections. Difficult words: government (people who lead a country), soldier (a person who works in the army), elections (a process when people choose candidates to represent them in government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Kashmir is in India. There are very many Muslims there. Kashmir has its own government. India changes this. Now, Kashmir must have a similar government to India. Many people are not happy and they protest . Police come. 4000 people go to prison . Many leaders go to prison, too. People in Kashmir vote for new leaders. Many people come and vote. However, people are not happy. They say that the vote is not fair. The problem is that a lot of leaders are in prison. Some leaders protest, too. They do not take part in the vote. Difficult words: protest (an official way to say that somebody does not agree with something), prison (a place where police put somebody who does something bad), vote (verb: choose a favorite person in politics, noun: the choice for the person in politics), take part (be a part of an activity or a process). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Canadian voters reelected the Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau, and his Liberal Party. To secure a majority government , one party needs 170 seats. However, Trudeau’s Liberal Party won 157 seats in the Parliament, which means it is a minority government . Trudeau has to work with other parties in the Parliament to pass legislation. At the moment, it is not clear which parties will form the minority government with the Liberals. In his speech after election, he said that he wants to make the standard of living better, fight climate change, and get guns off the streets. During his first time as Prime Minister, Trudeau focused on climate change, helping people that came from other countries, the legalization of cannabis, and a new free trade deal between Canada, the US and Mexico. Difficult words: majority government (a situation when a political party or parties have the most), minority government (opposite to majority government; a situation when a party needs help from other parties to pass laws), standard of living (how well someone lives in a place). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People in Canada voted Justin Trudeau the Prime Minister again. He is the leader of the Liberal Party. His party won 157 seats in the Parliament. It is not enough to make legislation. He needs to form a government with the help of other parties . At the moment, the parties are not known. Trudeau says that he wants to make better lives for Canadian people and make the streets safer. In the past, Trudeau focused on climate and helped people who came from Syria and Iraq. He also legalized a drug called cannabis and helped to make a deal between Canada, the US and Mexico. Difficult words: party (a political group in a government), environment (the natural world)), legalize (officially allow something, make it legal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People in Canada vote for a new Prime Minister . The winner is the current Prime Minister, Justin Trudeau. He is the leader of a group called the Liberals. He is in a difficult situation. He has 157 seats in the Canadian government for people from his group. It is not enough. He needs help of other groups to make laws. Trudeau wants better lives for people in Canada. He also wants to protect nature. He wants to make the streets safe. In the past, he focuses on nature also. He helps people from Syria and Iraq. He makes business with the US and Mexico. Difficult words: Prime Minister (a leader of a government), elections (a process when people choose a new person for a political post), seat (be a part of a group who can make decisions), protect (make something safe or better). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 2017 and 2018, terrible wildfires hit California. The company PG&E provides gas and electricity to an area in California, and it has had financial troubles since the fires. Many victims of the fires claimed damage accidentally caused by PG&E equipment. About 100,000 victims are eligible for money, but about 70,000 victims still have not filed for the money. They have little time to do this because the deadline is next Monday. Lawyers say that some victims did not understand the process or they thought they needed an attorney . Some people believed that they could not file a claim because they already got insurance money. Difficult words: claim (formally demand money after a disaster or an accident), eligible (have the right to get something), attorney (a person who acts for other people in legal matters), insurance (a deal which guarantees money or help for a problem ifa person pays money before the problem). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A company called PG&E gives gas and electricity to people in California. In 2017 and 2018, its equipment accidentally makes wildfires start. It is a big disaster for people in California. PG&E have money problems after the fires. Thousands of people want some money as compensation . About 100,000 people can get some money, but about 70,000 people must still officially ask for compensation. The problem is that they have to do this before next Monday. Lawyers want to postpone the date. Lawyers also say that many people do not understand the process. Some people do not believe that they can get some money. Difficult words: equipment (machines and tools needed for special work), compensation (money which somebody gets after a disaster or accident), postpone (change the date to a later time). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A company called PG&E gives gas and electricity to people in California. In 2017 and 2018 this company accidentally makes big wildfires in California. It is a big problem for local people and for PG&E, too. PG&E loses a lot of money. Now, over 170,000 people want some money back. This is very difficult. They have very little time. They must ask before next Monday. Lawyers want to help them. They want more time. Lawyers say that some people do not understand the situation. They do not know what to do. Some people do not think that they can get some money back. Difficult words: wildfire (a very large and fast fire in the woods or bush), local (people who live in the area), lawyer (a person who works for companies or people to help them in difficult situations). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In Northern Ireland, the UK Parliament will soon legalize same-sex marriage and abortion. Northern Ireland is the only part of the UK that does not allow same-sex marriage, and it has the most abortion rules. After Tuesday, people will stop investigating women who sought abortions. On Valentine’s Day 2020, same-sex couples will be allowed to be married. These changes are part of a bill that keeps Northern Ireland running without a government—since 2017, it has had no government. The bill would start on Monday at midnight if Northern Ireland could not restart its government. Some politicians met on Monday to stop the changes, but they were unable to elect a new speaker for their government. Difficult words: sought (past tense of “search”), bill (a set of laws that politicians pass on what people can or cannot do), speaker (the leader of a group of politicians in government). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Northern Ireland, the UK Parliament is going to legalize same-sex marriage and abortion. Soon people are going to stop investigations into women who wanted abortions. On Valentine’s Day 2020, same-sex couples can get married. These changes are part of a set of laws that Northern Ireland uses to run without a government. It does not have a government since 2017. The new laws start on Monday at midnight if Northern Ireland cannot choose a new government. Earlier on Monday, some government officials met to stop the changes, but they did not agree on who to elect as a new leader for their government. Difficult words: legalize (make legal, make something able to happen), investigation (a study into what happened), elect (choose a leader). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The UK government helps to run Northern Ireland. It is going to make changes there. It is going to let same – sex marriage and abortions be legal . Women can look for abortions and not get in trouble. Same-sex people can marry on Valentine’s Day, 2020. These changes are part of new laws for Northern Ireland. It uses the laws to run without a government. It does not have a government since 2017. On Monday, officials meet to stop the changes. They can stop the changes if they choose a new government. However, they cannot agree to choose a new leader. The changes start at 12 AM on Monday. Difficult words: run (when a large group or area works as one place), same-sex (men who like men and women who like women), abortion (when a pregnant woman does not have a baby), legal (when something can happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Currently, Lebanon has serious economic problems, and Lebanese people shouldered higher taxes. Then, when the government wanted to tax messaging platforms , people went out to the streets to protest, so the government removed the tax. However, the protesters did not stop. Now they want new politicians in the government that do not belong to political groups, and they asked for 30 politicians to give up their jobs to technocrats . Since then, four politicians have quit their jobs. The government met to make economic changes, such as by reducing the leaders’ pay by half. The president also met with some protesters, but most do not believe that the current government will fix these problems. Difficult words: shoulder (carry, deal with), platform (a website or a program), technocrat (a politician who has technical knowledge of running a government). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Lebanon has dire economic problems, and first, Lebanese people paid higher taxes. Then, the government wanted to tax messaging websites and programs, and people began to protest. The government scrapped the tax, but the protests did not stop. The people now want new leaders in the government that do not belong to political groups . They asked for 30 leaders to give up their jobs to new and different leaders. Since then, four leaders gave up their jobs. However, most protesters do not believe that the government is going to fix the problems. Difficult words: dire (serious), scrap (stop, give up), political group (people who have ideas on how to run a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Lebanon has economic problems. First, Lebanese people pay higher taxes . Then, the government wants to tax messaging websites and programs. People protest against this. The government stops the new tax. However, people still protest. They want new leaders in the government. They want 30 leaders to leave their jobs. After that, four leaders leave their jobs. The government meets to make economic changes. The president meets with some people who protest. Most people do not believe that the government is going to fix the problems. Difficult words: economic (related to the economy which is all of the money in a country), tax (noun: extra money you pay for something to the government; verb: make people pay extra money to the government), protest (tell the government or other people you are unhappy about something and you want it to change). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
